## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

**1. Global Risk Regime?**
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 6/11 sectors positive. XLK in CORRECTION (1W: -2.09% | 1M: +4.27%) while GLD ABOVE TREND (1W: +7.41% | 1M: +14.26%) and VXX BELOW TREND (1W: -4.99% | 1M: -15.94%) show mixed confirmations.

**2. Primary Risk Drivers?**
Credit modestly easing: HYG (1W: +0.49% | 1M: +1.31%) ABOVE TREND & LQD (1W: +0.96% | 1M: +0.76%) ABOVE TREND ↑ rising (credit relief). Fear lower but ambiguous: VXX (1W: -4.99% | 1M: -15.94%) BELOW TREND ↓ falling; gold rally: GLD (1W: +7.41% | 1M: +14.26%) ABOVE TREND ↑ rising.

**3. Financial Conditions Signal?**
Neutral-to-easier: UUP (1W: -0.71% | 1M: -2.31%) BELOW TREND ↓ falling shows dollar softening while TLT (1W: +2.22% | 1M: +0.07%) ABOVE TREND ↑ rising signals bond demand.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

**4. Sector Leadership?**
Materials XLB ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.31% | 1M: +7.12%) and Healthcare XLV ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.94% | 1M: +6.72%) showing strength; Tech XLK in CORRECTION (1W: -2.09% | 1M: +4.27%) and Energy XLE in CORRECTION (1W: -2.54% | 1M: +6.34%) lag. Style mixed / no clear leadership.

**5. US vs Global?**
US SPY in CORRECTION (1W: -0.20% | 1M: +3.63%) while EM EEM ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.92% | 1M: +5.71%) and China FXI ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.43% | 1M: +0.79%) showing relative outperformance.

**6. Speculative Appetite?**
Speculation is elevated: IBIT ABOVE TREND (1W: +22.19% | 1M: +21.62%), ETHA ABOVE TREND (1W: +28.81% | 1M: +26.44%) and ARKK ABOVE TREND (1W: +9.12% | 1M: +19.08%) — risk-on behavior in niches despite broad neutrality.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

**7. Commodities Theme?**
Precious metals leading: GLD ABOVE TREND (1W: +7.41% | 1M: +14.26%) and SLV ABOVE TREND (1W: +8.50% | 1M: +17.74%); industrials/copper supportive: CPER ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.03% | 1M: +5.13%).

**8. Energy Trend?**
Energy mixed: XLE in CORRECTION (1W: -2.54% | 1M: +6.34%) and BNO in CORRECTION (1W: -3.55% | 1M: +3.16%) while natural gas UNG ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.29% | 1M: +1.19%) shows localized strength.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

**9. Trend Confirmation?**
Confirmed: TLT ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.22% | 1M: +0.07%) and GLD ABOVE TREND (1W: +7.41% | 1M: +14.26%) both timeframes positive. Major divergence: SPY (CORRECTION), QQQ (CORRECTION) and XLK (CORRECTION) show 1W negative vs 1M positive — MAJOR Divergence that suppresses a one-sided regime call.

**10. Portfolio Direction?**
Favor selective cyclicals and inflation/hedge exposures (Materials XLB ABOVE TREND; Gold GLD ABOVE TREND) and reduce exposure to short-term tech momentum (XLK in CORRECTION); monitor speculative crypto ETFs (IBIT, ETHA).

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Sectors to Watch?**
BULLISH: Materials XLB ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.31% | 1M: +7.12%), Healthcare XLV ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.94% | 1M: +6.72%).  
BEARISH: Utilities XLU BELOW TREND (1W: -1.61% | 1M: -5.19%), Industrials XLI BELOW TREND (1W: -2.82% | 1M: -2.62%).

**12. Commodities to Watch?**
BULLISH: Gold GLD ABOVE TREND (1W: +7.41% | 1M: +14.26%), Silver SLV ABOVE TREND (1W: +8.50% | 1M: +17.74%).  
BEARISH: Brent BNO in CORRECTION (1W: -3.55% | 1M: +3.16%) — monitor for renewed weakness.

**13. Key Levels?**
VXX 20 (complacency threshold); HYG/LQD ~0.80 (credit health); SPY/TLT ~2.0 (stocks vs bonds pivot); IBIT 1W surge (> +20%) as a speculative heat gauge.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL. Breadth: 6/11 sectors positive, with mixed signals across risk indicators. Materials (XLB ABOVE TREND) and precious metals (GLD ABOVE TREND) showing strength while Tech (XLK in CORRECTION) and broad indices (SPY in CORRECTION) exhibit short-term weakness — watch the SPY/QQQ/XLK divergence.
